const cy=document.querySelector('#cy')._cyreg.cy; const f=cy.nodes('.scope-frame'); if(!f.length) return 'no frame'; const fb=f.boundingBox({includeLabels:false}); const lb=f.boundingBox({includeNodes:false,includeEdges:false,includeLabels:true,includeOverlays:false}); const t=cy.nodes('.this').boundingBox({}); return JSON.stringify(f.data('label'))+' | label at '+Math.round(lb.x1-fb.x1)+','+Math.round(lb.y1-fb.y1)+' from the frame corner, inside: '+(lb.x1>=fb.x1&&lb.y1>=fb.y1&&lb.x2<=fb.x2&&lb.y2<=fb.y2)+', overlaps title: '+!(lb.x2<t.x1||lb.x1>t.x2||lb.y2<t.y1||lb.y1>t.y2)+' | text-events '+f.style('text-events')
